title: Decision Nº 067/009/2004 CC.D of December 03, 2004
text:
KINGDOM OF CAMBODIA 
Nation Religion King 
 
The Constitutional Council 
 
 CASE 
Nº 090/013/2004 
Of November11, 2004 
 Decision 
Nº067/009/2004 CC.D 
Of December3, 2004 
 
THE CONSTITUTIONAL COUNCIL 
 
- Seen the Constitution of the Kingdom of Cambodia of 1993; 
- Seen Preah Reach Kram Nº CS/RKM/0498/06 of April 8,1998 on the Organization 
and the Functioning of the Constitutional Council; 
- Seen Preah Reach Kram Nº 02/NS/94 of July 20,1994 on the Organization and the 
Functioning of Council of Ministers; 
- Seen the decision Nº 09 CC.D of May 28,1999 of the Constitutional Council 
declaring that the Law on the Establishment of Ministry of Women Affairs and 
Veterans, adopted by the National Assembly on May 11,1999 and entirely reviewed 
by the Senate on May 17,1999 is unconstitutional; 
- Seen the decision Nº 12 CC.D of August 23,1999 of the Constitutional Council 
declaring that the Law on the Establishment of Ministry of Women Affairs and 
Veterans, adopted by the National Assembly on August 13,1999 and entirely 
reviewed by the Senate on Au gust 17, 1999 is constitutional; 
- Seen the letter Nº 305 NA of November 10, 2004 from Samdech HENG 
SAMRIN , Acting President of the National Assembly, requesting the 
Constitutional Council to examine the constitutionality of the Law on the 
Establis hment of Ministry of Women Affairs, letter received by the Secretariat 
General of the Constitutional Council on November 11, 2004; 
 Having heard the rapporteur, 
 Having deliberated in compliance with the law, 
- Whereas the Law on the Establishment of Ministry of Women Affairs, the 
constitutionality of which the President of the National Assembly requested to 
examine, is an Organic Law; therefore, the Constitutional Council has the 
competence to examine its constitutionality in conformity with the Article 140 N 
paragraph 2 of the Constitution; 
- Whereas the Articles 1 to 6, stipulating the Establishment of Ministry of Women 
Affairs, conform to the decision Nº 12 CC.D of August 13,1999 of the 
Constitutional Council and ha s no provision contrary to the Constitution; 
 
Decides: 
Article 1 : The Law on the Establishment of Ministry of Women Affairs adopted by the 
National Assembly on October 27, 2004 and entirely reviewed by the Senate 
on November 5, 2004 is declared constitut ional. 
Article 2 : The decision made in the plenary session of the Constitutional Council 
in Phnom Penh onDecember 3, 2004 shall be final without recourse, shall have 
authority over all the instituted powers as stipulated in the Constitution and shall 
be published in the “Journal Officiel” 
 Phnom Penh, December 3, 2004 
 For the Cons titutional Council 
 The President 
 Signed and Sealed 
 
 BIN CHHIN
summary: Decision Nº 067/009/2004 CC.D of December 03, 2004 : Request of Samdech HENG SAMRIN , Acting President the National Assembly, to the Constitutional Council for examining the constitutionality of the Law on the Establishment of Ministry of Women Affairs.
